title.narrative: To reduce HIV infections by 85%, new HIV infections among children by less than 4%, AIDS related deaths by 80% and HIV related stigma to 5%, all from 2010 baseline by 2025. - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), HIV, Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania (MoF)This program has the following goals: To reduce new HIV infections by 85% in 2025 from the 2010 baseline (110,000).. To reduce Mother to Child Transmission by the end of breastfeeding to ≤4% by 2025.. To reduce AIDS related deaths by 80% in 2025 from the 2010 baseline (64,000). To reduce HIV related stigma to <5% by 2025 from 2013 baseline of 28% for external stigma and 20.5% for internal stigma.. The objectives of this program are: To implement efficient testing strategies so that 95% of people living with HIV will know their status by 2025. To implement client centered ART care so that 95% of all people diagnosed with HIV are enrolled, followed up and receive timely and efficacious HAART by 2025. To optimize ART so that 95% of all people receiving ART will attain sustainable viral suppression by 2025. To reduce HIV related stigma by less than 5% by 2025 from 2013 baseline of 25% for external stigma and 20.5% for internal stigma.. To reduce the percentage of mother to child transmission at the end of breast feeding period, from an estimated 7.9% (in 2021), to <4% by the end of 2025. To improve supply chain system that ensures 100% of HIV commodities are available in health facilities at all times by 2025.

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for TZA-H-MOFP04
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
Outcome indicators targets and results for TZA-H-MOFP04
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed
Percentage of people living with HIV who know their HIV status at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of women and men aged 15-49 who report discriminatory attitudes towards people living with HIV
On-shelf availability: Percentage of facilities with tracer health products for the three diseases - HIV, TB, malaria (as applicable) available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Percentage of people living with HIV who report having experienced stigma and discrimination in the general community in the last 12 months

Percentage of people living with HIV reported on ART at the end of the last reporting period and newly initiating ART during the current reporting period who were not on ART at the end of current reporting period
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for TZA-H-MOFP04
Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretroviral medicine to reduce the risk of vertical transmission of HIV
Percentage of people newly diagnosed with HIV initiated on ART
Percentage of people who inject drugs receiving opioid substitution therapy
Percentage of reporting units which digitally enter and submit data at the reporting unit level using the electronic information system
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
Percentage of high-risk adolescent girls and young women reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Percentage of people who inject drugs reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of children (under 15) on ART among all children living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Number of individual HIV self-test kits distributed
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART with viral load test result
Percentage of people on ART among all people living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of people who inject drugs that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in KP-specific programs and know their results
Number of needles and syringes distributed per person who injects drugs per year by needle and syringe programs
